messages:
Aisha: Heads up — I'm starting the rollout for v2.14 to prod in ~10m. Canary on 3 hosts in us-west1. Please watch latency, 5xx, and tail CPU on hosts. I’ll post canary metrics once warm.
Megan: I'm on call and watching. Will keep an eye on the latency dashboard and traces. Ping me if anything spikes :eyes:
Jon: I'll run the quick sanity list once canary is up: health endpoints, embed endpoint, streaming handshake. If something fails I'll try a quick retry patch.
Deploy Bot: deploy-started: id=canary-1795004321 service=runtime version=v2.14 targets=3 region=us-west1
Linus: Noted. Quick checklist I ran locally:
```
# health
curl -sS https://prod.api.internal/health | jq .status
# tail logs for instance:
gcloud compute ssh canary-1 -- tail -n 200 /var/log/runtime.log
```
Priya: I'll watch cost/throughput and alert if work-queue latency jumps >20%.
Aisha: Canary is live. Jon — can you run smoke script and paste the small summary? Also confirm rollback script is ready in case.
Jon: Running now. Smoke: 50 short requests, end-to-end token latency median 120ms, p95 420ms, errors 0/50. No obvious anomalies. Rollback ready: `deploy rollback canary-1795004321 --force` (tested in staging).
Megan: I see a small p95 blip at +2m mark (420 -> 760ms) but traces show a single slow host; autoscale didn't trigger. I'm switching that host out of the canary group.
Deploy Bot: target-update: removed canary-2 from rotation, new target count=2
Aisha: Good call. Re-ran tests without canary-2: p95 380ms. No errors. Keeping rollout but holding further expansion for 10m.
Linus: Noticed one recurring WARN in runtime log: `KV cache miss fallback`. I'll open a tiny PR to add a defensive check, but not blocking rollout. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/842
Priya: Metrics look stable on throughput and cost. Will continue 15m watch and then promote if no regressions.
Jon: FYI I pushed a tiny hotfix to gracefully ignore that KV miss in the hot path (non-breaking). Patch included in next non-canary batch if we promote.
Megan: +1 from on-call. No alerts firing, traces look healthy. Ready to greenlight expansion at +15m if nothing else appears.
Aisha: Thanks team. I'll wait the 15m window then promote to full fleet. If anything urgent appears, call the rollback and I'll coordinate. :thumbsup:
Deploy Bot: deploy-complete: canary phase successful. next-action=hold_until_1795005210
